**Unit system:** CGS by default. Constants are provided in the separate CGS constants sheet.

## Mechanics & Gravity

| Equation | Description (CGS) |
| --- | --- |
| $F = ma$ | Force (dynes), mass (g), acceleration (cm/s$^2$) |
| $F_{\rm grav} = G\,\dfrac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$ | Newtonian gravity |
| $v_{\rm orb} = \sqrt{\dfrac{GM}{r}}$ | Circular orbital speed |
| $v_{\rm esc} = \sqrt{\dfrac{2GM}{R}}$ | Escape speed |
| $P^2 = \dfrac{4\pi^2}{G(M+m)} a^3$ | Kepler's 3rd Law (general) |
| $P^2 \approx \dfrac{4\pi^2}{GM} a^3$ | Kepler's 3rd Law ($M \gg m$) |
| $L = m v r$ | Angular momentum (circular orbit) |
| $E_K = \dfrac{1}{2} m v^2$ | Kinetic energy |
| $U_G = -\dfrac{GMm}{r}$ | Gravitational potential energy |
| $E = E_K + U_G$ | Total mechanical energy |
| $E_K \sim \dfrac{1}{2}|U_G|$ | Virial theorem (bound system) |

## Thermodynamics, Radiation & Light

| Equation | Description (CGS) |
| --- | --- |
| $P = n k_B T = \dfrac{\rho k_B T}{\mu m_H}$ | Ideal gas law |
| $E_{\rm th} = \dfrac{3}{2} k_B T$ | Thermal energy per particle |
| $c = \lambda \nu$ | Speed of light |
| $E_{\gamma} = h\nu = \dfrac{hc}{\lambda}$ | Photon energy |
| $F = \dfrac{L}{4\pi d^2}$ | Observed flux |
| $F = \sigma T_{\rm eff}^4$ | Stefan-Boltzmann (surface flux) |
| $L = 4\pi R^2 \sigma T_{\rm eff}^4$ | Luminosity |
| $\lambda_{\rm peak} T_{\rm eff} = b$ | Wien's law |
| $\dfrac{\Delta\lambda}{\lambda_0} = \dfrac{v_r}{c}$ | Doppler shift (non-rel.) |
| $E = 13.6\,\rm eV\left(\dfrac{1}{n_f^2} - \dfrac{1}{n_i^2}\right)$ | Hydrogen spectral lines |
| $P_{\rm rad} = \dfrac{1}{3} a T^4$ | Radiation pressure ($a=4\sigma/c$) |

## Magnitudes & Angular Size

| Equation | Description |
| --- | --- |
| $m_1 - m_2 = -2.5\log_{10}\!\left(\dfrac{F_1}{F_2}\right)$ | Apparent magnitude difference |
| $\mu = m - M = 5\log_{10}\!\left(\dfrac{d}{10\,\rm pc}\right)$ | Distance modulus |
| $\alpha = \dfrac{s}{d}$ | Angular size (radians) |
| $\Omega \approx \pi\alpha^2$ | Solid angle (small $\alpha$) |
| $d(\rm pc) = \dfrac{1}{p(\rm arcsec)}$ | Parallax distance |

## Stellar Structure & Scaling

| Equation | Description |
| --- | --- |
| $\dfrac{dM}{dr} = 4\pi r^2 \rho$ | Mass continuity |
| $\dfrac{dP}{dr} = -\rho\,\dfrac{GM(r)}{r^2}$ | Hydrostatic equilibrium |
| $\dfrac{dL}{dr} = 4\pi r^2 \rho\,\epsilon$ | Energy generation |
| $\dfrac{dT}{dr} = -\dfrac{3\kappa\rho L}{16\pi a c T^3 r^2}$ | Radiative transport |
| $P_c \sim \dfrac{GM^2}{R^4}$ | Central pressure scaling |
| $\rho_c \sim \dfrac{M}{R^3}$ | Central density scaling |
| $T_c \sim \dfrac{\mu m_p G M}{k_B R}$ | Central temperature scaling |
| $L \sim M^{3.5}$ | Luminosity scaling |
| $g \sim \dfrac{GM}{R^2}$ | Surface gravity scaling |
| $E_g \sim -\dfrac{GM^2}{R}$ | Gravitational binding energy |
| $\mu = \dfrac{1}{2X + \tfrac{3}{4}Y + \tfrac{1}{2}Z}$ | Mean molecular weight |
| $P_{\rm deg} \propto \dfrac{\rho^{5/3}}{m}$ | Degeneracy pressure (non-rel.) |
| $P_{\rm tot} = P_{\rm gas} + P_{\rm rad}(+P_{\rm deg})$ | Total pressure |

## Nuclear Fusion

| Equation | Description |
| --- | --- |
| $E_{\rm nuc} \approx \Delta m c^2$ | Mass-energy conversion |
| $\epsilon_{pp} \propto \rho T^4$ | PP chain rate (scaling) |
| $\epsilon_{CNO} \propto \rho T^{17}$ | CNO cycle rate (scaling) |
| $\epsilon_{3\alpha} \propto \rho^2 T^{40}$ | Triple-alpha rate (scaling) |
| $\epsilon_{ix} = \epsilon'_0 X_i X_x \rho^{\alpha} T^{\beta}$ | General fusion rate |
| $\lambda_{\rm dB} = \dfrac{h}{p}$ | de Broglie wavelength |

## Compact Objects & Remnants

| Equation | Description |
| --- | --- |
| $R_{\rm WD} \approx (0.01 R_\odot) \left(\dfrac{M_{\rm WD}}{0.7 M_\odot}\right)^{-1/3}$ | White dwarf radius (approx.) |
| $R_{\rm NS} \approx (10^6\,\rm cm) \left(\dfrac{M_{\rm NS}}{1.4 M_\odot}\right)^{-1/3}$ | Neutron star radius (approx.) |
| $M_{\rm Ch} \approx 1.4 M_\odot$ | Chandrasekhar limit |
| $R_S = \dfrac{2GM}{c^2}$ | Schwarzschild radius |

## Timescales

| Equation | Description |
| --- | --- |
| $t_{\rm nuc} \approx \dfrac{\epsilon_{\rm nuc} f M c^2}{L}$ | Nuclear timescale |
| $t_{\rm KH} \approx \dfrac{|E_g|}{L} \sim \dfrac{GM^2}{RL}$ | Kelvin-Helmholtz timescale |
| $t_{\rm dyn} \approx \sqrt{\dfrac{R^3}{GM}} \sim \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{G\rho_{\rm avg}}}$ | Dynamical timescale |
| $t_{\rm ff} \approx \sqrt{\dfrac{3\pi}{32G\rho_{\rm avg}}}$ | Free-fall timescale |

## Relativity & Quantum

| Equation | Description |
| --- | --- |
| $\gamma = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1 - v^2/c^2}}$ | Lorentz factor |
| $\Delta t = \gamma \Delta t_0$ | Time dilation |
| $L = L_0 / \gamma$ | Length contraction |
| $p = \gamma m_0 v$ | Relativistic momentum |
| $E_0 = m_0 c^2$ | Rest energy |
| $E^2 = (pc)^2 + (m_0 c^2)^2$ | Energy-momentum relation |
| $\Delta t = \dfrac{\Delta t_0}{\sqrt{1 - 2GM/rc^2}}$ | Gravitational time dilation |
| $1+z = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 2GM/rc^2}}$ | Gravitational redshift |
| $\Delta p\,\Delta x \gtrsim \hbar/2$ | Uncertainty principle |

## Galaxies & Cosmology

| Equation | Description |
| --- | --- |
| $v = H_0 d$ | Hubble's law |
| $v^2 = \dfrac{GM(<r)}{r}$ | Flat rotation curve |
| $1+z = \dfrac{\lambda_{\rm obs}}{\lambda_0}$ | Cosmological redshift |
| $a = (1+z)^{-1}$ | Scale factor |
| $H^2 = \dfrac{8\pi G}{3}\rho - \dfrac{k}{a^2}$ | Friedmann equation |
| $\rho_c = \dfrac{3H^2}{8\pi G}$ | Critical density |
| $\Omega_i = \dfrac{\rho_i}{\rho_c}$ | Density parameter |
| $\Omega_{\rm tot} = \Omega_m + \Omega_r + \Omega_\Lambda$ | Total density |
| $\rho_r \propto (1+z)^4$ | Radiation density scaling |
| $\rho_m \propto (1+z)^3$ | Matter density scaling |
| $\rho_\Lambda = \rm constant$ | Dark energy density |
| $T(z) = T_0 (1+z)$ | CMB temperature scaling |
